'''Shreya Ordassa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] at the [[University of Sanbra]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She attended an auction on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in the hopes of acquiring the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]].
